scenario: D3 - repackaged build (RASP self-integrity fires on-device; attestation fails server-side)

response.reason: Critical risk: on-device self-integrity reports the binary no longer matches its registered build baseline, and the platform attestation does not recognize the build. Both must be satisfied to reach CRITICAL.

notes: The decision is server-side. Even though a repackaged app could patch its local SDK to report risk_bits=0, it cannot suppress the server-derived attestation_fail, and it cannot mint a server-accepted decision. risk_signals are emitted in ascending bit order (app_tamper bit 4, attestation_fail bit 5) and match the webhook body in egress/webhook-body.json byte-for-byte. Meridian Pay runs in ENFORCEMENT_MODE_STEP_UP, where CRITICAL maps to DECISION_DENY; in ENFORCEMENT_MODE_OBSERVE the same event is recorded but allowed.
